basic_details.job_title: Mirzapur District Court Oath Commissioner Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Advocates practising at Mirzapur with at least two years of practice may apply for appointment as Oath Commissioners at Tehsils Sadar, Lalganj, Chunar and Madihan for the calendar year 2027. The Office of the District & Sessions Judge, Mirzapur has asked for applications on the prescribed format to be submitted only at the Administrative Office of Mirzapur Judgeship, where they will be received up to 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About Mirzapur District Court
content_sections.text: The Office of the District & Sessions Judge, Mirzapur (Uttar Pradesh) heads the Mirzapur Judgeship. The term of the Oath Commissioners appointed for the calendar year 2026 ends on 31 December 2026, so the District Judge has issued this Office Memorandum to appoint Oath Commissioners for 2027 at the four tehsils of the district.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only at the Administrative Office of Mirzapur Judgeship, Mirzapur. The Statement Clerk and Asst. Statement Clerk of the office will receive and collect applications up to 30 November 2026 only. The notice does not mention sending applications by post or email. Use the prescribed application format annexed with the Office Memorandum (page 2 of the notice). The form is in Hindi and is addressed to the Hon'ble District Judge (Mananiya Janpad Nyayadhish), Mirzapur (U.P.). Write the post and the place you are applying for (Headquarters/Chunar/Lalganj/Madihan) in the form heading, and paste your latest photograph in the box provided. Fill in all requisite particulars, including name, address, date of birth, educational qualifications, date of enrollment, total length of practice and other relevant details. Disclose whether you have applied for any other advertised post(s) and whether you have earlier worked as Amicus Curiae, Oath Commissioner, etc., mentioning the post(s) and year(s). Sign the declaration, which includes your undertaking to work in the Common Pool System. Attach the self-attested enclosures and submit the application at the Administrative Office of Mirzapur Judgeship by 30 November 2026. Name of the applicant, father's/husband's name, date of birth and caste (SC/ST/OBC/Gen.) Educational qualifications (three lines: a, b, c) and permanent address Annual income, place of working as an Advocate and period of practice as an Advocate (in years) Enrollment details with the Bar Council of India/Bar Council of U.P.: Enrollment Number, Date of Enrollment, C.O.P. Number, Date of C.O.P. and Validity of C.O.P. (date of expiry) Whether the applicant has applied for other advertised posts, and earlier work as Amicus Curiae (Nyay Mitra), Oath Commissioner, Survey Commissioner, General Commissioner, etc., with years Special experience or qualification, if any

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The Office Memorandum invites applications for the post of Oath Commissioner at Tehsils Sadar, Lalganj, Chunar and Madihan for the calendar year 2027. The number of posts and the pay are not specified in the notice. Only Advocates practising at Mirzapur may apply. The applicant must have experience of practice as an Advocate of not less than two years as on the date of issuance of the Office Memorandum (16 November 2026). The applicant must give an undertaking that they are ready to work in the common pool system. The notice does not mention an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopy of the Certificate of Enrollment issued by the Bar Council of Uttar Pradesh/Bar Council of India, as applicable Self-attested photocopy of the Certificate of Practice (C.O.P.) issued by the Bar Council of Uttar Pradesh/Bar Council of India, as applicable Any other documents, to be listed under "Others, please specify" in the enclosure checklist of the form The form asks applicants to tick (√) each enclosure attached in the checklist at the end of the form.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: After the last date, the Statement Clerk and Asst. Statement Clerk will sort and compile the applications received and prepare a consolidated list. The applications and the consolidated list will then be placed before the concerned Committee for further scrutiny and necessary action in accordance with the requirements and directions of the Committee.

rows.details: Prescribed format annexed with the Office Memorandum

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Oath Commissioner in Mirzapur?
faq.answer: Applications will be received and collected at the Administrative Office of Mirzapur Judgeship up to 30 November 2026 only.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for Oath Commissioner at Mirzapur?
faq.answer: Advocates practising at Mirzapur who have experience of practice as an Advocate of not less than two years as on 16 November 2026, the date of issuance of the Office Memorandum, can apply.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the Oath Commissioners be appointed?
faq.answer: The appointments are for Tehsils Sadar, Lalganj, Chunar and Madihan in Mirzapur.

faq.question: Q4. For what period is the appointment?
faq.answer: The Oath Commissioners will be appointed for the calendar year 2027, as the term of the present Oath Commissioners expires on 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for Mirzapur Oath Commissioner 2027?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed format annexed with the Office Memorandum, attach the self-attested enclosures and submit it only at the Administrative Office of Mirzapur Judgeship by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What documents must be attached to the application?
faq.answer: Self-attested photocopies of the Certificate of Enrollment and the Certificate of Practice (C.O.P.) issued by the Bar Council of Uttar Pradesh/Bar Council of India, as applicable, must accompany each application.

faq.question: Q7. How will the Oath Commissioners be selected?
faq.answer: The applications will be compiled into a consolidated list and placed before the concerned Committee for scrutiny and necessary action as per the Committee's requirements and directions.

faq.question: Q8. Is the common pool undertaking compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must give an undertaking that they are ready to work in the common pool system, and applications without it shall be rejected without prior notice.

faq.question: Q9. Must I disclose other posts I have applied for?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must disclose whether they have applied for any other advertised post(s) and whether they earlier worked as Amicus Curiae, Oath Commissioner, etc., with the post(s) and year(s).
